claims.excerpt: How GRACE Follow-On Tracks Changes in Earth’s Water
claims.claim: GRACE Follow-On tracks changes in Earth’s water.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: The mission follows changes involving groundwater, lakes and rivers, soil moisture, glaciers, ice sheets and changes in sea level attributable to water added to the oceans.
claims.narrative: Explain how GRACE Follow-On’s two satellites use changes in the distance between them to help investigate water movement on Earth.
claims.explanation: The title accurately summarizes the kinds of water-related changes the mission follows.
